(529)gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i rig 'dzin chen po so zur gnubs gsum brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i phyag bzhes o rgyan smin graul gling gi rol tshig spyi

tei:div.tei:p: gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i rig 'dzin chen po so zur gnubs gsum brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i phyag bzhes o rgyan smin graul gling gi rol tshig spyi 'gro la/ thog mar rol mo byin rlabs brgya rdung rgyas pa 'dra/ 'bring po'i/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'di yod med gnyis 'dug bsdus pa la thang gsum/ 'bebs/ bzhag rol/ byin 'bebs rgyud gsum/ chad tho rgyas pa che mchog pad+ma la/ 'grub par mdzodaḥ (Musical notes and signs here) 'bebs/ (Musical notes and signs here) yang de 'dra/ (Musical notes and signs here) lan gsum/ wor/ mthar/ 'bebs/ gsham sbrel dbyangs su brdung*/ dbyangs yod dbyangs rol/ gsham ma sbrel na bzhag rol/ bkra shis rol 'dra/ bsdus pa dbyangs med la bkra shis shog sum gnyis/ thang gsum/ 'bebs/ bzhag rol/ dbang dang rab gnas dus bgegs bskrad rol mo/ thang gcig (Musical notes and signs here) thing je brel mthar 'bebs chung*/ sum rdung 'jog nyis brtsegs dang dgu bcas/ 'bebs bzhag rol/ gsol ka spyan 'dren la glog ma bya na/ thang gsum/ che bzhi/ chung bzhi/ 'bebs/ gtor 'gugs la/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'jam por/ mthar drag 'bebs/ (Musical notes and signs here) smad las dus gser skyems la/ thang gsum/ 'bebs/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'gugs rol snga ma lta bu'i mthar/ snga ma gnyis dang*/ phyi ma'i mthar/ tshigs bcad yod na/drag rol rgyas pa/ (Musical notes and signs here) phur gdab thog mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lhaḥ khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nasaḥ shin tu= nas/ dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzodaḥ (Musical notes and signs here) drag rol 'bring po/ thing (530) shar phyogs dkar= khrag mdog= shin tu= nas 'dur/ de'i 'gres/ (Musical notes and signs here) dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs kyi tshogasaḥ

phung po dus bur gtubs la don snying ma lus sregasaḥ 'bebs/ bzhag rol/ drag rol bsdus pa/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ che mchog= 'dur/ des 'gres/ (Musical notes and signs here) gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlogasaḥ bzlog rol rgyas pa ni/ thang gsum/ 'bebs/ (Musical notes and signs here) bzlog rol chung ba/ (Musical notes and signs here) bzlog rol che chung gi 'then rnams la khams gyang mkhar lugs la rol mo bskor srol yod/ (Musical notes and signs here) dgra bigs dpung bcom thal ba'i rdul du rlogasaḥ ma ra ya rbadaḥ lan gsum/ de rnams kyi rags bsdus dbyangs med kyi rnga tshig tshang ma 'dir ma smos rigs stod las la sum brdung shas che ba dang*/ smad las la dgu rdung 'gro che'o/ mdos dang zor rnams bzlog gdangs bzlog rol chung ba kho nas gtong srol yod/ bsang la dbyangs raul zur du gsal/ dbyangs med na sum rdung gis stod las ltar gtong chog rnga tshig 'di rnams khams dang*/ dbus su 'dra min cung zad snang yang*/ 'dir gtso bo gyang mkhar lugs bla ma rin po che a stobs kyi phyag rgyun dang*/ dgra bgegs dpung bcom kyi rnga tshig sogs dbus lugs ltar yin no/// /
